method: Read-only database snapshot; reconstruct current controller unit lists and first-level BOM/formula material projections, then execute actual Vue prepareRowUnits/resolveBomConversion/getBomQuantity methods with host test doubles. No HTTP/UI end-to-end execution, no dispatch records saved.

findings.recommendation: Re-select the intended output unit in BOM V1 and save a complete unit snapshot. If one batch is intended, use conversion 346 (1 batch = 201.7 kg); confirm the batch basis before changing data. Changing only the conversion ID leaves the snapshot incomplete.
